description: Creates a Solana payment invoice for your API key: kind "topup" adds call credit ($5-$500, usd_amount, default $5); kind "subscription" buys 30 days. Returns payment_id, the exact pay_amount and wallet_address. Send exactly pay_amount, then call check_payment. Max 3 pending invoices per key.

api_key.description: Optional. Your RiskDataApi key, for MCP hosts that cannot send an Authorization header. If both are present, the Authorization header wins.

usd_amount.description: Top-up amount in USD, 5-500 (default 5); ignored for subscription

name: create_topup_invoice
title: Create a top-up or subscription invoice
